metric: AN-05: strong = share of pixels whose largest RGB channel differs by more than 64 after a 3x3 box blur; mean = mean largest RGB channel difference (0-255); heightDifference = |native - Cordova| px at scale 3. Each case passes within its value plus `margin`.

reasons.S09 states (settings, picker*, confirm,: Glyph rasterization of the titles, descriptions, weekday labels, alarm rows, slider labels and popup texts (WebKit places glyphs on its own subpixel grid; Korean falls back to Apple SD Gothic Neo in both; English titles are a few tenths of a point wider in WebKit), the switch's shadow and the hour bar's anti-aliased handle lines. Cards, borders, rows, weekday buttons, the bar and the popups are at the captured positions within 1 px after the measured offsets (AlarmsView: the weekday buttons 2/3 pt up, Cancel / Save 1/3 pt down, the picker's heading 1/2 pt down and its arrows 1/3 pt left, the grid labels as measured). Compared from the top to 20 pt under Cancel / Save; the rest is checked as the page's background.
reasons.intro, foreground: O06 and O07 over the Hourly tab, compared in the popup's box only: the Hourly page under the backdrop shows through the popup's 90 % white (a light page stands in), plus glyph rasterization of the title, the lines and the buttons.
reasons.headroom: Each case is its local measurement (`measured`, Xcode 27.2, iOS 26.5 simulator) times 1.5 plus 0.0005 for strong and times 1.2 plus 0.2 for mean, rounded up, plus `margin`: CI renders with Xcode 26.6, whose text rasterization IN-08 measured up to about twice as far from WebKit on text-heavy blocks. The height must match.
